Docs.summary: Provides a bounded, least-recently-used cache of texture-backed images for a Graphite recorder.

remarks.format:
## Remarks
Use an image cache to avoid re-uploading the same image to the GPU on every frame. Pass its <xref:SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteImageCache.FindOrCreate(SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteRecorder,SkiaSharp.SKImage,System.Boolean)> method as the callback when creating a recorder so repeated draws of the same source image reuse a single uploaded texture. The cache evicts the least-recently-used entries once it reaches its capacity.
This type implements `IDisposable`. Dispose it when done, either with a `using` statement or by calling `Dispose()` directly, to release the cached GPU images.
